leo_cs: Onboarding for Nimbus reporting bursts of failures on first-page load: mix of 429s and HTTP/2 RST_STREAMs. They call SDK init ~80x on SPA mount.
ana_platform: Can you share the gateway logs and a client stack trace?
leo_cs: Client shows `Error: stream error: stream ID 29; RST_STREAM (11)` intermittently. Gateway shows `429 /v1/preflight` and `connection closed: GOAWAY` clustered at 00:13:22.
dev_sdk: RST_STREAM 11 usually means server closed stream under resource pressure. Does their user base use a lightweight client-side bundle that spawns many frames?
leo_cs: It's a React app that mounts many microfrontends; each does sdk.init() before shared context is ready.
kai_infra: Edge observability shows pool eu-west-1-pool-4 hitting h2 stream soft-limit alarm. We have stream-shedding that sends GOAWAY when avg CPU > 78% for 1m.
dev_sdk: Short-term SDK workaround: expose an opt-in init coalescer. We can also add jittered backoff for token fetches and expose `maxInitConcurrency` default 8.
nana_platform: Can we reproduce quickly? Any small script?
leo_cs: Repro: `node parallel_init.js 100` (attached) -> ~35% RST_STREAM, ~12% 429.
kai_infra: I can temporarily raise h2.max_concurrent_streams to 200 for pool-4 for 1h and disable aggressive GOAWAY on that pool for the window. Want me to?
leo_cs: Please do. Customer is about to run a demo tomorrow.
kai_infra: Done: pool eu-west-1-pool-4 h2.max_concurrent_streams=200, GOAWAY-threshold paused until +1h. Monitoring CPU and stream errors.
dev_sdk: I'll craft a tiny client patch: coalesce window 75ms, single ephemeral token cache per origin, and fallback to long-poll if preflight fails 3x. Canary it in SDK beta.
nana_platform: Also add a note in onboarding checklist: "For SPAs with many microfrontends, avoid calling sdk.init() per microfrontend; use a shared init or enable coalescing."
leo_cs: After infra bump customer retried and failures dropped to ~4%. They can demo, will roll out our SDK beta afterwards.
deploy-bot: Deployment started -> service(sdksvc): canary-2026-03-21-014, sha=def456
dev_sdk: Canary running. Preflight coalesce logic logs: `coalescer: merged 47 inits into 3 requests` on canary-1. No perf regressions.
leo_cs: Great. I'll follow up with Nimbus in 24 hours and schedule enablement to add coalescer flag to their config. Thanks all :raised_hands:
